material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 12 to Jul 15 (+52%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−0.2% to −7.5%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Nov 20, 2025 high in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from May 30, 2025 to Jan 16 and a pullback of 0.60 of them to the Mar 12 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−17%); a close over the wave-1 high (+27%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.
